events.title: Damage Challenge for Next Fest
events.summary: Do you have the best balls?Ahoy & welcome to the first DWARRF Damage Competition!To celebrate this October Next Fest I am challenging YOU to deal the most damage you can using just one ball. This ball can damage multiple enemies, be stacked with runes & synergise with all the relics you can get your hands on!Prizes:1st place: $50 Steam Gift Card & In-game golden bobblehead2nd place: In-game silver bobblehead3rd place: In-game bronze bobbleheadFull rules & Submission info https://yetibytes.com/20

events.title: No Time To Loot Festival
events.summary: Ahoy!DWARRF: A Pinball Roguelike is participating in the No time to Loot Festival! So grab your balls and set sail and see what other loot filled games await you on Steam.For everyone joining us this week for the first time, please try out the demo for DWARRF and give feedback in the forms linked in-game.
